q1_issues.issue: "by 88 percent" / "by 80 percent" states the extent of the reduction, but (Measure sk_lower_1 risk 88 percent) reads as the lowering event itself measuring 88 percent on a risk scale — a Measure on an event is licensed only for duration.
The modal "would" is dropped: nothing marks the lowering as hypothetical / predicted rather than an unmarked generic eventuality.

q2_gaps: "V by N percent" — a percentage extent-of-change adverbial on an event has no licensed carrier (Measure is entity+dimension, MoreBy is a comparative gap, Fraction is a partitive level)
"would" as a hypothetical / future-in-past modal is not in the status-predicate inventory (only will/might/probably/must/can, plus the subjunctive Counterfactual construction)
notes: Routing is right: say as a non-factive attitude with the whole complement sealed under Theme, the gapped second conjunct expanded into its own lower event, and the definite pill/risk typings projected at top level. Of on the risk witnesses is the entity-attached preposition oblique, so licensed.
